title: Star Emoji & Kaomoji: Copy & Paste ⭐ 🌟 ✨ Starry Combos
meta_description: Star emoji ⭐ 🌟 ✨, five-star rating combos, night-sky sets, and star kaomoji for reviews, captions, and cosmic vibes. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: Rating stars, glowing stars, shooting stars, sparkles, and star-eyed kaomoji — the full picture-emoji star set. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: The star emoji ⭐ is one of the internet's most practical picture emoji — a single tap builds a ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ five-star review, rates a product, or crowns a favorite in a caption. This page collects the full picture-emoji star family, from the ⭐ rating star to the 🌟 glowing star, ✨ sparkles, and 🌠 shooting star, plus night-sky companions and star-eyed kaomoji like (☆ω☆). These are full-color emoji that render as little pictures — if you want plain-text Unicode stars like ★ and ☆ that paste anywhere as characters, see the star symbols collection at /library/star-symbols/ (kaomoji and ASCII star art live on their own linked pages too). Copy a single star, a kaomoji, or a ready-made combo set with one click.
